headline: Gold edges up ₹11 today; silver flat at ₹2,05,000 per kg
summary: Today's change is tiny: 24K gold rose ₹11 per gram (0.08%) to ₹14,357, and 22K rose ₹10 to ₹13,160. Silver was unchanged at ₹2,05,000 per kg. Over the last 7 days gold is up about 3.38% and silver up 2.5%, while silver is down 6.82% over the 13 days covered by the data, from its ₹2,20,000 level on 26 October. Likely drivers include the US dollar and rupee movements and festive or wedding demand, though these are possibilities rather than confirmed causes.
outlook: Prices are close to today's level, so there is no urgency either way; compare the making charges and GST at your jeweller before buying.
